# Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto 2.2.1-rc.4

K5-focused test release, published as a normal GitHub release. The RC label indicates hardware validation is still pending.

## Wireless connection cleanup
- Retain direct OEM hotspot startup (mode 2) and the stock hotspot feature request.
- Keep HMG-API projection AP delegation, park teardown, delayed Bonjour restart and projection arbitration removed.
- Remove the Mobis SystemPopup activity interception, its unused framework hook declaration and associated component constants.
- Preserve the original Phone Projection settings menu correction.
- Retain the existing Bluetooth SPP delay, iAP2 recovery and post-connect timers; no new connection delays.
- Preserve all existing vehicle compatibility, firmware fingerprints, native recipes, AA support, audio, navigation and diagnostic settings.

## Automatic opening
- Add **Automatically open wireless CarPlay**, enabled by default; restart to apply.
- After a successful wireless session-start callback, request the stock K5 DiPO activity on the main thread once per session.
- Suppress duplicate callbacks and invalidate queued opening on session finalization.
- Resolve the activity before opening; log and skip an unavailable target or launch failure without modifying the connection.
- Independent of the bridge, TBT and audio settings; no polling, sleeps, retries or projection AP dependencies.

## Ultra identity
- Restore the full-tuple Ultra theme identity as the standard serializer format.
- Log the exact selected iAP2 theme wire format for CPUL integration diagnostics.

## Build and testing
- Signed with the existing fork author key; includes HMG-API ZIP, NEMESIS packages and SHA256SUMS.
- HMG-API minimum version and SDK pin unchanged.
- Compare connection timing against rc7.log.2 on HMG-API rc9 using the same phone and conditions. Test cold boot, QuickBoot, repeated disconnect/reconnect, automatic opening enabled/disabled, manual exit and CPUL integration.
- Automatic foreground behavior and connection-performance improvement are not yet verified on hardware. Full instruction-level equivalence with log2 remains unverified. Keep a known-good rollback package.
